if: the supply is a supply of services
an invoice is issued under rule 46
the invoice is not one prepared in the manner specified in rule 48(4)
then: the invoice MUST be prepared in duplicate, marked ORIGINAL FOR RECIPIENT and DUPLICATE FOR SUPPLIER
note: There is no transporter copy for services. Rule 48(6) switches this off for an invoice prepared under rule 48(4).

evidence.quote: The invoice shall be prepared in duplicate, in the case of the supply of services, in the following manner, namely,-
the original copy being marked as ORIGINAL FOR RECIPIENT; and
the duplicate copy being marked as DUPLICATE FOR SUPPLIER.
The provisions of sub-rules (1) and (2) shall not apply to an invoice prepared in the manner specified in sub-rule (4).
